item.title: PCSO turns over grant for newest Institutional partner in Mindanao
item.description: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) further strengthened its commitment to inclusive education and social welfare as it formally turned over a ₱485,000 grant to its newest institutional Partner, the Community of Hope Special Education Center (COHSEC), on December 12, 2025, at the premises of the beneficiary institution in Mindanao. The post PCSO turns over grant for newest Institutional partner in Mindanao first appeared on Fastbreak.

item.title: PCSO Brings Free Medical, Dental Services to Alitagtag, Batangas
item.description: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) showed its commitment to the health and well-being of Batangueños through a Medical and Dental Mission held in the municipality of Alitagtag, Batangas on November 20, 2025. The post PCSO Brings Free Medical, Dental Services to Alitagtag, Batangas first appeared on Fastbreak.

item.title: PCSO Turns Over P900,000 Institutional Partnership Grant to Life Home Mindanao, Inc.
item.description: KORONADAL CITY — The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) turned over a ₱900,000 grant under Institutional Partnership Program (IPP) to Life Home Mindanao, Inc. during a ceremonial check turnover held at the PCSO South Cotabato Branch Office on December 4, 2025.
